scope: Original 2017 WizKids Sidereal Confluence: Trading and Negotiation in the Elysian Quadrant, ten-page SC_Rule Book_061017_Web5 and original printed nine-species fact sheets including Faderan reverse. Excludes 2020 Remastered, expansions, and optional variants.

questions.question: What is the ordinary phase order, when does trading end, and may players still invent immediately before running their Economy?

An agreed future delivery becomes impossible. Everyone rejects substitute compensation. After delivering what is possible, the player still owes one card, one octagon, two cubes and one ship. What must happen and how many points are lost; can the score go negative?
If a player trades a species-background economic card, a colony and an uninvented research team, which normally return, and when?

How and when does a player invent from a research team they control, which printed cost is paid, when do the inventor and other species put their matching cards in play, and when is the Sharing Bonus collected?
For a named-card upgrade, must both cards be in play with their owner, where does the spent card go, and can the newly renamed upgraded card still pay an upgrade requiring its old name?
At ordinary Economy, when is Colony Support checked, where do excess colonies go, can a white converter be skipped or run twice, and can one converter output fund another in that same Economy?
For ordinary donation output, where is it kept and what must its producer do during the next Trade Phase? May a recipient refuse a gift, and are donation victory points tradable?
How are ordinary colony and research bids committed and resolved? If I bid five ships for a minimum-two card, how much do I spend on buying it; what happens if I pass or no legal card is left?
After both bid rounds, which unbought cards are removed, where and in which orientation do they go, and how are tracks refilled?

Using standard final scoring, what happens to donations generated in the last Economy, how many points do 2 octagons, 4 large cubes, 3 small cubes and 3 ships add, and how is a tied final score broken?
Caylion commits five ships for a colony. What is its effective bid? When is a seedling token added, and does it stay if that colony is upgraded or traded?

May the Eni Et run their own interest converters or upgrade them? A borrower runs an interest converter with two large input cubes and four large output cubes using one blue cube and one large Unity wild: what four cubes result?

A non-Faderan player holding three Acknowledgments invents two technologies in one Trade Phase. Can they trade tokens to somebody else or save them, and what tokens and points move on those two inventions?

Does each back in the Faderan relic deck grant a separate draw activation? In what phase is the deck converter used, how is the deck prepared, and can Relic Detector provide a second draw that turn at what additional cost?
How may Im’dril Fleet Support be allocated across converters, what must accompany a loan of a support-requiring card, and do borrowed cards lacking support symbols require fleets?
When may Kjasjavikalimm split a five-ship colony bid, into which bids, and may a half be split again? After buying with the first half, which colony count is used for a tie on the second?
Can Kt’Zr’Kt’Rtl split or rearrange their starting paired cards, upgrade only one half, or loan a pair? How do nullspace colonies enter play, transfer to other players and leave play if consumed?
Which cube colors can large and small Unity wild cubes replace, may Unity wild inputs mix colors, and can Zeth steal Unity wild resources?

Does an unlicensed player receive a newly invented Yengii technology at Confluence? When may Yengii license it, what card does the recipient get and for how long, and can licensing restore a card spent underneath an upgrade?

When do Zeth steal, can two stealing converters hit the same player that turn, and is a player protected after trading with Zeth, after gifting donations to Zeth, or after receiving Envoys output only as a gift?
During setup, who chooses a species first, which cards begin in play, how are the remaining species cards kept, and which starting colonies/research teams are dealt?

In a five-player game including Kjasjavikalimm, which player count governs each bid track and the Confluence cards, how many of each are selected, how is the technology deck ordered and initially dealt, and which information on the species card is visible after final setup?
Which goods may be hidden behind a screen, do physical shortages cap ships/resources/points, and may ships of a different species design be produced or traded as normal ships?

May a three-player trade be contingent on all its exchanges happening, what assent is needed, and is a promised future donation-point delivery binding? If one promised point cannot be delivered and no compensation is agreed, what penalty applies after doing everything possible?

May ordinary earned victory points be traded, and are the approximate resource values printed in the booklet automatic exchange rates that let a player replace a converter required input with any equal-valued resource?
Can a converter with no input be used for free, and what is the exception that permits running a violet converter on a card still out of play?
May a card be upgraded by either printed route, what happens to other output of its violet upgrade converter, and does flipping a colony preserve its original climate?
An ordinary colony is consumed by a converter requiring its climate. Where and in what orientation does it go, is the deck shuffled, and in what order do discarded colonies recur?
A non-Yengii invents an era-IV technology. Do the other species receive their versions during Confluence, and does the ordinary invention process still give its inventor immediate access?
Can players negotiate while bids are resolved, may they immediately transfer payment promised for leaving a card, and are such promises binding?
A player already at Colony Support buys another colony in Confluence. Is the purchase legal, and by when may they trade or consume the excess to avoid losing a colony?
For Caylion, can a one-ship colony bid buy a minimum-one colony, are research bids also halved, and does halving reduce the actual ships paid for a successful colony purchase?

A seeded Caylion colony has an economic converter and a violet upgrade converter. How often can the economic converter run, can one run fund its second use, is the upgrade cost doubled, and what happens to the seedling if the colony is discarded beneath the deck?
A Caylion starting-card upgrade produces a point and yellow cube. In which phase is this produced, and can that yellow be traded immediately?

A borrower feeds an Eni Et interest converter entirely with Unity wild cubes of the required size. Does the converter make more wilds or destroy those inputs, and how are the rest of its outputs chosen?
Faderan uses the ordinary converter on the relic deck back. What exact inputs does the illustrated original converter require and where does the consumed ordinary colony go?
When Automated Transport Network is played from the relic deck, what is taken immediately; can its support be loaned and can Im’dril use it to keep colonies in Economy?

When Contextual Integrator Cache enters from the deck with seven Acknowledgments held outside Faderan, how many points does Faderan gain, what holdings count, and does loaning the Cache change its behavior?

With Contextual Integrator Cache active, a player holding an Acknowledgment invents using small cubes, and later one using octagons while still holding another token. How does the cost change for each, may the player defer token use, and does Faderan still earn its usual token points?
What does Paradise Converter consume and award, when and how often may it run, and where does an ordinary consumed colony go?
What points does Star’s Ruin award when played from the deck if the current Invention Bonus is six, and can later trades of that card award those entry points again?

In a turn, a non-Faderan trades Gift of the Duruntai away first, and its recipient trades it again. Who receives resources on each trade, does it return to Faderan at turn end, and what if Faderan had made the first trade away instead?

A player with no points wants to run Nalgorian Grindstone using a point another economic converter produces this Economy. Is it legal, what must be paid and to whom, and what if they already had a point?

How and when does an Im’dril fleet other than the starred starting fleet enter play, what immediate point is gained, and can Im’dril normally keep a colony into Economy merely because it won a colony bid?
For Kjasjavikalimm territory tiles, where do they start, when do the top and bottom converters run and what does each do, are tiles treated as cards, and may an in-play tile be loaned?

With Kt’Zr’Kt’Rtl holding more colonies than its opponent, who wins an equal colony bid? How many colonies can Kt support? On a research bid does Kt ignore research-team counts, and what if those counts also tie?

Unity acquires a second ordinary colony while it can support one. May it consume a colony of any climate to enter/flip a qualifying Unity card, when must it dispose of excess, and how do its four computer worlds enter play?

Yengii has two uncompleted research teams and three invented technologies splayed before it. How many count against it in a research-bid tie, where are Yengii inventions kept, which Sharing Bonus does it receive, and does it still get other species’ normally shared technologies?

May Zeth split Envoys factory output among several players, can its required gift be refused, may Zeth gift a spare envoy token from its stash, and may recipients trade tokens between themselves or back?

A legal Zeth stealing converter asks for three large cubes but its sole unprotected target has only one ordinary large cube plus two large Unity wilds. What can Zeth take, may the shortfall come from another player, and are envoy tokens spent to unlock cheaper theft inputs?
Can the same named card be spent for two upgrades, and is the target actually flipped when the named-card route is used?

A borrowed upgraded Eni Et interest converter does not produce more cubes than it consumes. Is that alone a reason it cannot run, and can its ordinary colored cube inputs be one blue and one yellow when a single color is required?

Kjas splits five colony-bid ships into three and two. Can the three-ship half buy a minimum-four colony; if that half passes, are those three ships spent or kept? Can the two-ship half still buy an available minimum-two colony, and what does that purchase cost?
A player offers donation resources to Zeth explicitly as payment in a negotiated Trade rather than a gift. Must Zeth accept, and if it accepts does the donor gain theft protection for that turn?
For standard final scoring, do two small cubes and one ship make a scoring group together, how many points is that group, and can one remaining large cube complete it instead?
May players negotiate or speak with each other while some players are still running Economy, or transfer a trade there after producing a missing input?
When a research-team preview shows a converter with unspecified output colors, must every species produce the same colors from that invention or use its own matching economic card?
How many Trade phases, ordinary Economies, scoring-only Economies and colony/research bid Confluences occur over the original game? What is the phase sequence on Turn 6 and is there a seventh Trade?
For the original Final Confluence card, what ordinary invention-sharing bonus applies at four, six and eight players, and what does Yengii receive at each of those counts?
During the final scoring-only Economy, may a player use input cubes of the wrong color, may output colors be ignored if sizes are correct, and can the output then fund an invention after Economy?
Do Zeth get a final theft before scoring, at what precise point, and may they ignore the colors of the resources they must pay as stealing-converter inputs just because it is the last turn?
Relic Detector has entered from the original relic deck. What immediate point does it grant, and may Faderan loan or trade it to another species like an ordinary Faderan relic?
Does Caylion’s starting colony have a seedling token, and does an ordinary tokenless colony gained later by trade receive a new seedling merely because Caylion receives it?
When a Kt’Zr’Kt’Rtl nullspace colony’s top converter is run during Trade, does it immediately give that colony’s economic resources as well as entering the colony?
May a gray Unity wild cube satisfy a Unity wild input of its own size, and may a large gray wild instead pay a small-cube input just because it is wild?

A non-Yengii invents two technologies whose printed invention awards are four and three points, with current Sharing Bonus six. How many points arrive in Trade and in Confluence, do sharing and matching-card entry precede bidding, and which bid type resolves first?
